float_pipeline.hdr_metadata_scope: declared HDR10 mastering-display/CLL with decoded-prefix verification
float_pipeline.color_transforms_backend: CPU Float64 tiled -> Float32; composition uses selected CPU/OpenCL backend
float_pipeline.projection_budget_scope: each float projection/composite/delivery call; not total process RSS

timeline.curve_clock: existing adaptive Float64 author clock;see compilation certificate
timeline.native_holds: original PTS to next PTS;last native duration establishes EOF
timeline.nested_clock: continuous author time;exact left/right limits propagated through reversal

adjustments.clock: selected sequence tick minus declared layer start; no frame-grid resnap
adjustments.nested_application: once at selected root; child canvases are not graded twice
adjustments.intervals: start-inclusive/end-exclusive; clipped coverage retains original animation clock
adjustments.workspace_scope: existing per-effect explicit quota; not aggregate process RSS

tracking.clock: selected original PTS * native time base minus recorded demux origin; no CFR resnap
tracking.geometry: same crop/fit/TRS inverse as rendered source; integer pixel centres and half-pixel edges
tracking.ROI_reference: source geometry at target original author start; first observation if no native frame covers reference
tracking.scale_policy: existing binding clamp 0.01..20; source projected ROI-width ratio
tracking.alpha: binding base opacity times actual rendered source canvas alpha and scalar opacity; transition footprint mass clamped to 0..1
tracking.visibility: source coverage/range/crop/mute, pixel alpha, mask and own edge/paired transition source contribution; higher tracks and natural identity unverified
tracking.transition_geometry: alpha-weighted bilinear point footprint through the actual 59 transition kernels; centroid; missing required ROI footprint hides target
tracking.pinned_reference_clock: reference_output_tick on original complete source output

timeline.input_contract: validated Agent Project IR;registered SHA and explicit common working RGB signal

float_pipeline.integer_colour_conversion: zscale explicit RGB full/2020_ncl YCbCr; unchanged transfer; left chroma
float_pipeline.source_lifecycle: original inputs locked through publication; providers closed on render context exit
